description:
Go's built-in slog package transforms messy logs into clean, searchable JSON that your observability tools will love. In this video, I'll show you how to set up structured logging in Go, add custom attributes, handle errors properly, and even integrate with popular logging libraries like Zap. Whether you're debugging locally or managing production logs, slog will make your life easier and your debugging sessions shorter.
